description: Social graph. One row per relationship - a friend REQUEST is simply a friendship in 'pending', there is no separate requests table. Addressed by email because no user-search endpoint exists; the recipient discovers invites by filtering on addressee_email. Import FIFTEENTH (no dependencies)
notes: Users live in Xano, not Baserow, so every user reference is a TEXT field holding String(user.id) - never a link field.
Emails must be stored lowercased by the client; all lookups compare lowercased.
requester_* is always the initiator. addressee_user_id is null until the invite is accepted.
The *_name / *_avatar_url columns are denormalized snapshots and may go stale. Accepted tradeoff.

requester_user_id.description: Xano user id as a string

addressee_email.description: Lowercased. The only thing known about the recipient at invite time

pair_key.description: min(idA,idB)+':'+max(idA,idB) once accepted - guards against duplicate friendships

sample_data.invite_message: Let's keep each other honest this quarter.
